feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete F11 user settings flow readable and operable at high Quest3 eye-density, including sharp atlas-scaled main tabs, resizeable input hitboxes, first-run guide navigation and persistent confirmation, without losing native Windows gamepad/keyboard settings or saved user font size.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only external F11 ImGui modal/shell presentation and its existing input/persistence contract; do not modify gameplay HUD/ESC, +TIME, GOAL, rank, lens, 3D, DXVK, DX11, FFB, SkyGlow or R26_SAFE renderer ownership.
trace_stages: Native F11 key/overlay input goes through Win32 forwarding and original game WndProc with protected hotkey, focus and Alt routing.
Sharp source-side ImGui font atlas density and F11 shell/modal budget place child scroll content, slider hitboxes and persistent confirmation before DX9 draw submission.
External overlay SCREEN_OVERLAY_2D draw scope is retained for the two-eye R84 stereo hook and OpenXR host; Desktop and non-game presentation keep the original native window.
subcomponents: Bound XR first-run popup geometry and independent font scaling from the live render viewport while preserving the main F11 sharp-atlas and user font scale policies.

Move first-run guidance/slider into a separately scrollable body so confirmation remains outside the scroll child and reachable during Quest3 gamepad or mouse use; retain original settings finalizer and desktop Win32 fallback.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: XR F11 popup typography and confirmation hitbox
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Quest3 3440x1440 source and native portrait eye atlas fit the first-run popup without cropped giant text, with long guide/slider scrollable and the confirmation button always outside scrolling guide content.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Desktop native input and saved F11 settings
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: On low-resolution, source-eye mismatch and corrupt/zero reset extents, the portable modal computation fails closed, while existing F11 Win32/gamepad focus, user font preference, atlas quality and unchanged desktop popup/shell persist.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Windows game and host package, cross-domain source and policy
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Final exact validation-bearing SHA compiles Win32 game plus x64 OpenXR host, runs portable F11 layout regression and all applicable DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and HUD Inspector required gates; Quest3 optical acceptance remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.root_cause: The main F11 settings shell used XR density with a per-window font fit and scrolling child tabs, but the independent first-run welcome popup kept full atlas font pixels and placed a confirmation action after a long help body in the same scrollable popup. Height caps therefore cannot ensure the action remains accessible for Quest3 gamepad-only navigation.
diagnosis.original_evidence: The pre-edit overlay.cpp render_shell applied responsiveFit.fontScale, while render_first_run_intro only capped popupHeight and appended the Let's go button after all help and slider text under a single popup scroll owner. At high density/limited mirror heights that footer could be scrolled away rather than remaining reachable.
source_trace: Legacy F11 preflight hooks_overlay.cpp calculates VR atlas multiplier and routes keyboard/gamepad input; no original WndProc or FFB code was changed.
New F11 first-run per-popup ComputeFirstRunModal uses the source viewport and XR font density and applies SetWindowFontScale before body/control construction.
First-run child scroll owns guide/slider only; confirmation is placed after EndChild in its parent modal, all submitted in the existing external ImGui ScreenOverlay2D stereo scope.
alternatives_rejected: Changing game HUD scale or OpenXR eye resolution cannot repair the first-run ImGui window's local overflow and would risk working stereo/FFB/SkyGlow; rebuilding the already-sharp atlas or enlarging the full popup cannot reserve a fixed actionable footer.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No new stereo classification or per-eye FOV change. ImGui submits one source-space F11 popup with a stable fixed footer through the existing explicitly owned external ScreenOverlay2D draw, leaving R84/host two-eye projection unchanged.
